description:
We are participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 focusing on the "Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots" challenge.

We are looking for passionate teammates with skills in:

 * Data Analysis & Earth Science

 * Coding & Software Development

 * Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

 * Data Visualization

Join us if you are excited about processing satellite data and building impactful environmental solutions!
